Repairing the GEO600 vacuum system in 2019

On 22 and 23 October 2019, the GEO600 team together with a vacuum welding company closed the leak in the GEO600 north arm.

After the leak had occurred on 1 August 2017 it was closed temporarily with vacuum glue. Another application of glue was needed in mid December 2018.
In October 2019 the north arm was sealed off from the rest of the detector and filled with high-purity dry nitrogen. This allowed welding the leak, closing it permanently, while not endangering the high quality of the GEO600 vacuum.

Read more about the initial leak, how the GEO600 team effort saved the day (and the detector), and this final repair at in the @LIGO@scicomm.xyz Magazine: https://www.aei.mpg.de/1207055/LIGO-magazine-issue16v2.pdf (page 20 and following).
